## Overview

MarkdStage v2.5.0 exports Markdown speaker notes into editable PowerPoint files as
standards-compatible notes pages with readable plain text. PowerPoint bullet spacing is also
improved for more consistent exported layouts. Japanese PowerPoint exports keep kicker text on one
line and disable inappropriate English proofing marks while preserving editable native text.

GitHub Releases now include the standalone CLI tarball and its SHA-256 checksum for offline,
version-pinned installation. The English and Japanese user guides consolidate installation
instructions for the Canvas Extension, CLI, and Desktop surfaces.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks, Canvas Extension
installations, CLI commands, and Desktop workflows.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v2.5.0`. |
| Offline CLI installation | Download and install `markdstage-markdstage-2.5.0.tgz` from the GitHub Release. |
| PowerPoint export | No migration is required; existing speaker notes are included automatically in newly exported files. |
